step_type.description: Action family. Open string so adapters can extend.

required.description: Whether this step is required for run success.

capture_mode.description: Optional per-step override of manifest.capture_mode. Producers MAY change the active capture mode mid-run (e.g. start in `metadata`, upgrade to `screenshots` after the first failed verifier check). When present, this is the mode in effect for THIS step's artifacts. Consumers MUST treat absence as 'inherits the manifest mode'. Closes #36.

costs.description: Per-step cost breakdown for training-data hygiene. All fields optional; absence means the producer didn't measure that dimension. Sum of components SHOULD equal total_usd within float tolerance. Closes #58.

observation_pre.description: Bundle-relative path to the pre-action observation artifact (PNG). Or null if not captured.

observation_post.description: Bundle-relative path to the post-action observation artifact (PNG). Or null if not captured.

dispatch_backend.description: Adapter-specific dispatch backend identifier (e.g. cdp, cdp_som, playwright, pyautogui).

score.description: Continuous reward signal (0..1). The status enum stays the canonical pass/fail bucket; score is additive metadata for RL/SFT pipelines that need partial credit. Default mapping when absent: passed→1.0, recoverable→0.5, failed/skipped/unknown→0.0. Closes #59.

score_components.description: Optional breakdown of `score` into named contributions (e.g. grounding_accuracy, verifier_confidence, state_change_observed). Schema-free so adapters can extend per-domain.

comparator.description: Who produced `score`. `verifier` = the producer's automated check, `model-judge` = an external LLM rater, `exact-match` = deterministic string/coord compare, `human` = manual annotation.

events.description: Bundle-relative paths to decision-event JSONL files for this step.

logs.description: Bundle-relative log references. May include `#L<line>` or `#L<start>-L<end>` anchors.

captured_versions.description: Per-step version axes used by the platform's causal-attribution engine to disentangle which input changed when an outcome moves. All fields optional. Auto-stamped by `session.record_modelio()` (model + prompt_hash) and extensible via `session.set_step_versions()`. Closes #10.

judge_decisions.description: Per-step judge decisions — rule-based, model-based, human, or hybrid. A sibling list to the operative `verdict` block; preserves provenance so the platform can compare rule-vs-model-vs-human verdicts and route confidence-aware alerts. Closes #17.

verdict_source.description: Identifies which judge produced the operative `verdict` block when judge_decisions is non-empty. By convention: `<judge_type>:<judge_id>` (e.g. `human:reviewer42`). Closes #17.

branch_context.description: Propagated from the session-level branch_context onto every step so server-side filters can exclude replay-branch trajectories from production cohorts by default. Closes #15.

env_fingerprint.description: Structural environment fingerprint at step time. Stored side-by-side with the visual fingerprint (observation.hashes.phash_64), not merged. Lets the platform's determinism checker attribute drift to agent/model/env independently. Closes #13.
